'''SalaciousCrumb LU/L SalaciousCrumbStyle''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SalaciousCrumb]]
* '''Published:''' 16 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 LU SalaciousCrumb LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

speeders are hunting

== Strategy ==

get out the generals
->ANSB->echo sites/sensors->2-1B
->pilots of ability 2

get out luke, zev and hobbie in their speeders+weapons(nick of time)

use wedge to cancel opponent's battle destinies

use insurrection + bacta tank + 2-1B to be nearly immune to battle damage and to get your characters out the next round

hold hoth and frostbite

make damage using the objective and kill everything with your weapons

that's it, now try to win ;)
